sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Dennis through bulk removal
sections.text: The first physical task is collecting standing wastewater with equipment suited to the reachable conditions. Loose contaminated material and components approved for disposal will be handled through the planned route. Items held for another decision will remain separate from the waste stream.

sections.title: Expose the surface before treating it
sections.text: After clearing, we will review the retained components rather than apply a product over material that still needs physical removal. Cleaning will address soil and residue using methods appropriate to the surface. Any disinfection specified in the plan follows that cleaning step; it does not make an inaccessible or unsuitable component automatically recoverable.

sections.title: Dry the treated section before replacement
sections.text: We will evaluate remaining moisture and explain the drying needed for the affected assembly. The record will distinguish liquid extraction, material removal, cleaning and drying. The installer replacing insulation or other components will receive the actual completed boundary and any unresolved section.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/dennis.estimate: The estimate will identify those cleanup stages separately from drain repair and reconstruction. Share which material has already been removed so the proposal addresses the remaining condition rather than assumes every original component is still present.
checklist: Identify the drain repair location.
Share earlier pumping or removal records.
Tell us who will replace disposed building material.
